name: @bytetrue/pi-background-terminal
description: Pi extension: background_run starts shell commands hands-off with automatic exit notifications; background tasks are hard-capped at 28800s (8h) with renewal via restart. The optional 300s foreground shell cap is the separate pi-bash-timeout small extensio
